description: This Java class 'UpdateFileParser' parses an XML file named 'update.rdf' related to module updates in the OpenMRS project. It reads the XML content, extracts update information such as module ID, current version, and download URL, and handles different configuration versions (1.0 and 1.1). The class provides methods to parse the XML content, retrieve update details, and manage internal state related to module updates.
